written: before the 144-flop panel is drawn and before any new flop is solved
why: A4 registered branch for precision_limited: no blind outer steps; denser board panel for the terminal(s) that set the floor, reusing the 72 boards. Both terminals set the floor (max half-width node 6 0.075, node 28 0.068). 144 is the minimum option reported (+72 flops per terminal).
separate_from: A3 (94502b8, sealed) and A4 (481857e); nothing in either is modified

panel.rule: nested: panel_v2_72 verbatim + 6 more draws per stratum continuing the same sequential scheme (proportional to raw-flop count, without replacement, from the stratum pool minus the 72); weight = P(s)/12; same 12 strata, probabilities and estimator
panel.seed: 20261002 (advance by one on a coverage failure, same coverage rule as v2; every rejected attempt recorded)

solves.terminals: outer_m28_6/k14/terminal_node28.json and terminal_node6.json (the P14 ranges at which the existing 72 k14 flops were solved)
solves.boards: the 72 new boards only; the 72 existing k14 artifacts are reused through aggregate.py --flop-dir-extra (provenance key must match except the panel hash, which must be v3's or its parent v2's)
solves.settings: solve_panel.py, menu_m2_single_v1, postflop 1000 0.3 25, workers 4 x threads 1, same solver binary as A3

preflop.F72: one frozen-table preflop solve with {28: V14_72, 6: V14_72}
preflop.F144: one frozen-table preflop solve with {28: V14_144, 6: V14_144}
preflop.note: measured tables, no damping (at a fixed point used = measured); same config/seeds/400 iterations as A3/A4

bootstrap: 30 replicates each for F72 and F144: stratified resample of the panel's boards (seed 20261001 scheme of A4), table = V14 on the resampled boards for both terminals, one preflop solve per replicate

quantities.h72, h144: 95% percentile half-width and SD per main aggregate
quantities.scaling: h144/h72 (sqrt-n expectation 0.71; reported, not a pass criterion)
quantities.panel_shift: |F144 - F72| per main aggregate, compared with h72 and h144
quantities.nonlinearity_shift: bootstrap mean - point, at 72 and at 144

readings_fixed_before_results.consistent: every |F144 - F72| <= h72: the 72-flop estimate is inside its own stated resolution
readings_fixed_before_results.inconsistent: some |F144 - F72| > h72: the 72-flop half-width understates its error (recorded as-is, cause isolated)
